name: turbo-console
description: Unofficial VS Code extension for Turborepo
author: Artiom Tofan artiomtofancv@gmail.com

scripts.integration: esbuild test/suite/activation.suite.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=dist-test/suite.cjs && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('.vsix',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository --out .vsix/turbo-console.vsix && node test/run-integration.ts
